vb_textbox.text: There isn't a clear winner when it comes to gnome selection, the performance of every gnome can go up and down. The gnomes in total are 4 and will always show up in pairs, basically two pairs of gnomes alternating every turn. Initially you will have to randomly select a gnome, if that gnome gives you at least 6-7 mushrooms I suggest to stick with it and to change to the other one only if it start going below 5. The performance overall will go up and down in waves anyway, so don't panic if both gnomes start giving you low scores
